research_task.title: Preserve and replay the orbit-pruning bundle

summary: A fresh strict-height orbit-pruning bundle is digest-identified and deterministically reproducible under Node v24.19.0. Two verifier runs matched ten payload digests and reproduced a locally authored expected record byte-for-byte. The absent historical bundle was not recovered, and the Lean theorem candidate remains uncompiled.

value_assessment.novelty: The supplied prior orbit-pruning reviews reported a paper proof or finite check but no preserved executable artifact. This run adds a digest-bound local source candidate, exact input, expected record, checker, verifier, and repeated replay; it does not authenticate or reproduce the absent historical bundle.
value_assessment.evidence: Independent SHA-256 computation matched ten manifest payloads and the outer manifest. Two runs under the pinned dependency-free Node runtime produced identical verifier output and a byte-identical expected record; five applicable cases had target and retained totals 10 and 3, and three explicit countermodels isolated the predicate hypotheses.
value_assessment.falsifier: Any declared digest mismatch, unequal repeated verifier output, generated-output byte mismatch, or applicable listed case with unequal existence truth values would overturn the scoped replay result.

claims.statement: All ten declared payload digests and the outer manifest digest matched independently recomputed SHA-256 values at the verified checkpoint.
claims.evidence_summary: The manifest-aware verifier accepted every payload, and a separate native hashing pass accepted every payload plus the outer manifest.
claims.verification_method: Recompute SHA-256 for each declared payload and the manifest and compare the complete hexadecimal values.

claims.statement: Two replays under Node v24.19.0 produced identical verifier output and generated output byte-equal to the locally authored expected record.
claims.evidence_summary: Both runs accepted ten payloads, the runtime version, and expected-output equality with the same output digest.
claims.verification_method: Run the manifest-aware verifier twice under the pinned runtime and compare complete outputs and expected-record bytes.

claims.statement: Five assumption-satisfying strict-height cases have target and retained totals 10 and 3 with matching existence truth values, while three finite countermodels show that each predicate hypothesis is individually necessary for arbitrary predicates.
claims.evidence_summary: Exact rational membership checks cover maximal delta, zero height, the strict height boundary, the centerline, and separate violations of conjugation, reflection, and real-axis exclusion.
claims.verification_method: Check exact point membership, both symmetry closures, real-axis exclusion, target counts, and retained counts directly and with the checker.

claims.statement: Lean, Lake, and Elan were unavailable as applications, so the candidate theorem was not compiled or dependency-audited.
claims.evidence_summary: An application-only resolution probe returned missing results for all three tools while resolving the pinned Node runtime.
claims.verification_method: Repeat application-only resolution for the three Lean tools in the same environment.

limitations: The Lean candidate is uncompiled, so syntax, elaboration, declaration dependencies, and compiled axiom status are unknown.
The Mathlib release tag is not an immutable resolved dependency lock and no dependency tree is cached.
The expected record is locally authored and lacks historical or external sign-off.
The historical bundle and historical counts remain irreproducible because no such artifacts were supplied.
Finite exact cases do not prove the universal theorem.
Mutation-rejection testing was planned but not completed.
The abstract pruning result supplies no off-critical-line zeta zero.
failed_approaches: The preferred fast file-search executable could not be launched because local execution was denied, so native recursive enumeration was used.
The first checker replay failed under inherited ECMAScript-module semantics; a bundle-local CommonJS declaration corrected the packaging failure.
next_actions: Resolve an immutable offline Lean and Mathlib dependency set, compile and inspect the theorem declaration, and independently test rejection of modified input and expected records.

proposed_tasks.title: Compile and adversarially replay the preserved bundle
proposed_tasks.objective: Resolve immutable offline Lean and Mathlib dependencies, compile the preserved theorem, inspect its axioms, and independently test checker rejection of modified records.
proposed_tasks.rationale: The finite checker replay is reproducible, while formal acceptance, immutable dependency pinning, and mutation rejection remain unresolved.
proposed_tasks.success_criteria: All dependency digests verify, the source compiles without unfinished proofs or unexpected axioms, the declaration matches the strict contract, canonical counts replay, and altered records are rejected.
proposed_tasks.useful_failure_criteria: Record an exact dependency mismatch, compiler error, trust-expanding declaration, theorem mismatch, count mismatch, or mutation accepted unexpectedly.
proposed_tasks.verification_method: Build in a clean offline pinned environment, inspect the declaration dependency report, replay the canonical record twice, and rerun with one input and one expected count changed.
